visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing glasses and a suit stands against a purple background that mimics a live-streaming interface. He holds a glass jar with a red label and gestures toward the camera with an enthusiastic expression. (2) Graphic overlays of various snack bags and another jar appear around the man as he continues to speak energetically. The background shows a simulated chat feed and interactive buttons. (3) The scene cuts to a mobile screen capture of a website named 'chiwanla.com'. The page displays a large '22% SALE' graphic and various promotional banners for snack products. (4) The video returns to the man in the studio, who is now holding a bowl of snacks. He gestures toward the floating product graphics and gives a thumbs up, encouraging viewers to take action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Mandarin at a fast rate, accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic beat. The speaker's tone is welcoming and sales-oriented. (2) A clear 'whoosh' sound effect occurs, signifying a transition, while the speaker's intensity increases to emphasize a discount offer. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) During the transition to the screen recording, the voice remains continuous and authoritative, explaining the website layout. No background environment noise is present, suggesting a high-quality studio recording. (4) The clip concludes with the speaker delivering a final enthusiastic call-to-action, with the electronic music swelling slightly before the hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Presentation -> Proof -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for '吃完了嗎' (Chiwanla), an online snack retailer. It uses a fast-paced, live-stream aesthetic to announce a significant storewide discount and visually demonstrates how users can find these deals on the website, aiming to drive immediate purchases.
